name: Banner
description: A full-width top-of-page announcement bar. Use for site-wide or page-level status messages. Supports four semantic variants: info, success, warning, danger.

notes: Danger and warning banners use role='alert' (assertive).
Success and info banners use role='status' (polite).
When onClose is provided, a dismiss button is rendered with an accessible label.
Banner should be placed near the top of the page to communicate site-wide context.

children.description: Banner content. May include text, links, or inline elements.

actionText.description: Text for an inline action button rendered alongside the message. Requires onAction.

onAction.description: Callback fired when the action button is clicked.

onClose.description: When provided, a dismiss button is rendered at the inline-end.

do: Place at the very top of the page above main navigation.
Keep banner content brief — one or two sentences at most.
Use 'danger' for maintenance windows or breaking issues.
dont: Do not use Banner for form-level errors — use Alert.
Do not show multiple banners simultaneously.
Do not place heavy content or images inside a Banner.
